issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency: the problem description (problem_statement.md) refers to the method as get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case) while the exercise UML, the template's TODO comment, and the solution implementation use the camelCase name getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This mismatch (snake_case in prose vs camelCase in UML/template/solution) can confuse students about the exact method name required by the tests and the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the problem statement use the same camelCase method name as the UML and template: replace get_total_number_of_students() with getTotalNumberOfStudents(), or add an explicit note that the expected method name follows the camelCase convention shown in the UML and template. This keeps wording and code examples consistent and avoids student confusion.
